jobs.title: Plant Manager, STL
jobs.description:
Kemira is a global leader in sustainable chemistry for water intensive industries. For more than 100 years, our chemistry has advanced human progress and quality of life. We call it chemistry with a purpose, better every day. At Kemira, we foster a collaborative and inclusive work culture that empowers our employees to thrive and make a difference. Learn more about Kemira at www.kemira.com/careers.

We are now looking for a Plant Manager for our St. Louis site who is people-focused to lead all aspects of operations at our chemical manufacturing facility. This role is responsible for providing strategic and day-to-day leadership across production, maintenance, engineering, safety, quality, and site administration to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient plant performance.

The Plant Manager will play a critical role in building a strong site culture centered on teamwork, accountability, communication, employee engagement, and operational excellence. The ideal candidate will be a visible leader who can develop talent, strengthen cross-functional collaboration, drive continuous improvement, and create alignment across the organization while delivering business results.

**In This Role You Will Be Responsible For**

* Provide overall leadership and direction for all plant operations, ensuring safe, compliant, and efficient manufacturing performance.
* Build and maintain a strong site culture focused on teamwork, accountability, employee engagement, communication, and continuous improvement.
* Lead, coach, and develop site leadership and hourly teams to create a high-performing organization with strong employee ownership and accountability.
* Serve as a visible and active leader within the facility, fostering trust, collaboration, and strong working relationships across all functions.
* Drive a world-class safety culture by ensuring compliance with all environmental, health, safety (EHS), Process Safety Management (PSM), and regulatory requirements.
* Establish clear operational expectations, goals, and performance metrics while holding teams accountable for results.
* Collaborate with operations, maintenance, engineering, supply chain, quality, and commercial teams to optimize plant performance and customer satisfaction.
* Lead efforts to improve operational reliability, productivity, quality, and cost performance.
* Develop and execute plant strategies aligned with company objectives and long-term business goals.
* Manage plant budgets, capital expenditures, staffing plans, and operational resources.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives utilizing Lean Manufacturing, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and operational excellence principles.
* Support talent development, succession planning, employee training, and workforce engagement initiatives across the site.
* Lead plant response efforts during operational upsets, emergencies, and audits.
* Ensure strong communication and alignment between site leadership, corporate leadership, and plant personnel.

**What You’ll Bring To The Team**

* Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, or related field preferred; equivalent manufacturing leadership experience considered.
* Minimum 8 years of experience in manufacturing or chemical plant operations, with at least 5 years in progressive leadership roles.
* Proven experience leading teams within a process manufacturing environment.
* Strong leadership presence with demonstrated ability to build teams, develop employees, and improve organizational culture.
* Experience managing plant operations, production, maintenance, safety, quality, and financial performance.
* Working knowledge of OSHA, EPA, PSM, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Strong communication, conflict resolution, organizational, and decision-making skills.
* Experience with SAP or similar ERP systems preferred.
* Ability to lead effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic manufacturing environment.
* Any other duties as assigned

**Preferred**

* Experience leading operations in a PSM-regulated chemical manufacturing facility.
* Strong background in operational excellence, Lean Manufacturing, and continuous improvement.
* Experience managing capital projects, turnarounds, and major operational improvement programs.
* Six Sigma, Lean, or other operational excellence certifications preferred.
* Demonstrated success improving employee engagement, retention, and site culture.

**What You Can Expect From Us**

* Work with a global company that is committed to innovation, cares for people and dedicated to customer success.
* Opportunity for personal and professional growth
* Attractive benefits package compensation
* A multicultural and positive working environment

The starting salary range for consideration for this position is
**$122,500 to $152,500 per year**
with opportunities for performance-based bonuses. The actual starting salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to relevant employment history & experience, skill set/competencies, qualifications, and other business and organizational needs. We also offer a comprehensive benefits package which includes health insurance, paid time off, life/disability insurance and a 401k retirement plan (which includes a company match).

Kemira is a global leader in sustainable chemistry for water-intensive industries. We operate globally and serve a wide range of customers including municipal and industrial water treatment companies and the fiber industry. Our solutions and services help secure clean water for millions of people every day and support our customers in advancing circularity and responsible resource use throughout their value chains. In 2025, Kemira reported annual revenue of EUR 2.8 billion with a global team of 4,911 colleagues. Kemira is listed on the Nasdaq Helsinki. www.kemira.com

jobs.title: Environmental Services Manager
jobs.description:
**About Eco Constructors**

Eco is an environmental service provider that protects, establishes, and provides stewardship for ecological resources. We're in an active growth phase, building out new service lines and expanding our footprint across Missouri and Illinois.

**The Opportunity**

This is a leadership role for someone who wants to build something, not just manage it. Roughly half of this role is taking ownership of the SWPPP business we already have — leading the team, standardizing how we do the work, and growing revenue on a proven service. The other half is a blank canvas: identifying, building, and selling new revenue streams that don't exist yet. If you're energized by both the operational rigor of running a compliance-driven team *and* the challenge of creating and growing something new, this role is built for you.

What You'll DoLead the Environmental Services Team

* Take ownership of Eco's SWPPP inspection operations, serving as the direct manager for all SWPPP inspectors
* Conduct SWPPP inspections yourself on a regular basis, staying close to the field work and maintaining technical credibility with the team
* Centralize and standardize SWPPP reporting across all sites — building consistent templates, formats, and quality standards so that every report meets the same bar regardless of who wrote it
* Establish clear inspection scheduling, quality control, and compliance-tracking processes
* Serve as the internal subject-matter expert on SWPPP/NPDES compliance requirements across Missouri and Illinois

Grow SWPPP Revenue

* Own the growth targets for the existing SWPPP inspection line
* Identify and pursue new SWPPP client relationships, working alongside business development
* Build repeatable systems (pricing, proposal templates, client onboarding) that make it easier to scale the SWPPP business without sacrificing quality

Expand Our Service Offerings

* Identify and lead the development of new inspection-based service lines that leverage the same field skill set, client relationships, and compliance expertise
* Develop the market approach for each new line: pricing models, target client segmentation, service delivery standards, and go-to-market strategy
* Build the operational playbook for scaling new service lines profitably, in partnership with company leadership

Team & Process Leadership

* Recruit, train, and develop SWPPP inspectors as the team grows
* Set performance standards and provide ongoing coaching and quality feedback
* Report regularly to ownership on team performance, revenue growth, and new line development progress
* Represent Eco professionally with clients, regulators, and partner organizations

What We're Looking For

* Strong working knowledge of SWPPP/NPDES stormwater compliance requirements (Missouri and Illinois experience a plus)
* Understanding of MS4 permit programs and requirements, including how municipal stormwater compliance obligations shape client needs
* Prior experience conducting stormwater/erosion control inspections; CPESC, CESSWI, CISEC, or similar certification preferred (or willingness to obtain)
* Experience managing or leading a team of field inspectors or similar technical staff
* Demonstrated ability to build or scale a business, service line, or operational process — this could be entrepreneurial experience, intrapreneurial experience, or a strong track record of "owning" growth within a company
* Proven ability to sell — comfortable proactively hunting and closing new SWPPP work, not just managing existing accounts, as well as identifying and winning new revenue streams
* Comfort operating with real revenue and growth accountability, not just task completion
* Strong organizational skills — this person will be the one who brings order and consistency to reporting across the team
* Valid driver's license and willingness to travel to job sites across the MO/IL bi-state region
* Self-directed and comfortable with a hybrid work structure that combines field time, client-facing work, and independent/WFH focus

What Success Looks Like

* SWPPP reporting is fully standardized and centralized, with consistent quality across all inspectors
* SWPPP inspection revenue is growing year over year under this person's ownership
* New service lines are operational, generating revenue, and positioned to scale
* The Environmental Services Team operates smoothly with clear leadership, low turnover, and strong client satisfaction

Why Join Eco Constructors

* Genuine ownership of a growing services business, with real room to shape its direction
* Direct access to and support from company leadership — this isn't a role buried in a large bureaucracy
* Hybrid/WFH flexibility for the right person who can manage their own schedule and priorities
* The opportunity to grow with the company as it scales — this role has real room to expand in scope and compensation as the services business grows

Pay: $60,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Opportunities for advancement
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Pacific, MO 63069

**Summary**
-----------

**Now hiring:**

The Veterans Canteen Service (VCS) Central Office, located at the Jefferson Barracks VA Medical Center in St. Louis, MO, is currently recruiting for the Human Resources Specialist - Classification position within our Human Resources Division.

Learn more about this agency

  

**This job is open to**
-----------------------

### **The public**

U.S. Citizens, Nationals or those who owe allegiance to the U.S.

### **Veterans**

Veterans of the U.S. Armed Forces or a spouse, widow, widower or parent of a veteran, who may be eligible for derived preference

### **Recent graduates**

Individuals who have graduated from an accredited educational institute or certificate program within the last 2 years or 6 years for Veterans.

  

**Duties**
----------

**Major Duties and Responsibilities:**

* **Position Review & Consultation**: Partner with supervisors and hiring managers to review vacant positions and ensure position descriptions accurately reflect job duties and organizational needs.
* **Position Description Management**: Maintain current position descriptions by tracking required reviews and updating documents within established timeframes.
* **Job Classification**: Analyze duties, responsibilities, and qualification requirements to determine appropriate job classifications, pay grades, and position descriptions.
* **Classification Standards & Compliance**: Develop and maintain job classification standards using OPM guidance and classification methodologies, ensuring compliance with federal regulations.
* **Position Management**: Manage position records within the HR system, including creating and modifying positions and maintaining organizational structures with appropriate approvals.
* **Management Guidance**: Advise managers on position classification, organizational structure, position management, and applicable HR policies and regulations.
* **Classification Resolution**: Research and resolve complex classification issues by interpreting regulations, applying classification standards, and communicating recommendations to stakeholders.
* **Additional Responsibilities & Flexibility:** Perform and adapt to additional responsibilities as needed.

  

**Requirements**
----------------

### **Conditions of employment**

As a Condition of Employment for accepting this position, you will be required to serve a 1-year trial period during which we will evaluate your fitness and whether your continued employment advances the public interest. In determining if your employment advances the public interest, we may consider:  
  

* Your performance and conduct
* The needs and interests of the agency
* Whether your continued employment would advance organizational goals of the agency or the Government
* Whether your continued employment would advance the efficiency of the Federal service

  
Upon completion of your trial period, your employment will be terminated unless you receive certification, in writing, that your continued employment advances the public interest.  
  
Additional Conditions of Employment include:  
  

* Selective Service Registration is required for males born after 12/31/1959.
* Subject to background/security investigation.

### **Qualifications**

* **Relevant Human Resources Experience:** Bachelor's degree **OR** a minimum of three (3) years of general Human Resources experience demonstrating strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills, **OR** equivalent leadership experience in a food or retail environment.
* **Human Resources Knowledge**: Working knowledge of HR principles, practices, and procedures, with the ability to interpret and apply HR policies, guidelines, and regulations.
* **Federal HR Expertise**: Experience applying Federal Human Resources regulations, including 38 U.S.C. 7802, Title 5, and Title 38, in support of HR operations and decision-making.
* **Collaboration & Relationship Building**: Ability to work effectively with Human Resources professionals across Veterans Canteen Service (VCS) and Veterans Health Administration (VHA), while clearly communicating and supporting VCS hiring policies and procedures.
* **Communication Skills**: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present information clearly and professionally to employees, managers, and leadership.
* **Core HR Functional Knowledge**: Experience in one or more core Human Resources functions, including Personnel Actions, Recruitment and Placement, Classification, Compensation and Benefits, Employee and Labor Relations, Training, and Reasonable Accommodation.
* **HR Consultation & Guidance**: Ability to provide guidance and recommendations to managers and senior leaders on Human Resources policies, procedures, and best practices.
* **Organization & Time Management**: Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and adapt to changing business needs in a fast-paced environment.
* **Microsoft Office Proficiency**: Minimum intermediate-level proficiency in the Microsoft Office Suite, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, with the ability to create and edit documents, analyze data, develop presentations, manage calendars and email communications, and utilize these tools to support daily business operations efficiently.

### **Additional information**

Candidates should be committed to improving the efficiency of the Federal government, passionate about the ideals of our American republic, and committed to upholding the rule of law and the United States Constitution.

Benefits
========

A career with the U.S. government provides employees with a comprehensive benefits package. As a federal employee, you and your family will have access to a range of benefits that are designed to make your federal career very rewarding. Opens in a new windowLearn more about federal benefits.

Eligibility for benefits depends on the type of position you hold and whether your position is full-time, part-time or intermittent. Contact the hiring agency for more information on the specific benefits offered.

  

**How you will be evaluated**
-----------------------------

You will be evaluated for this job based on how well you meet the qualifications above.

**IN DESCRIBING YOUR EXPERIENCE, PLEASE BE CLEAR AND SPECIFIC. WE MAY NOT MAKE ASSUMPTIONS REGARDING YOUR EXPERIENCE. Your application, résumé, C.V., and/or supporting documentation will be verified. Please follow all instructions carefully. Errors or omissions may affect consideration for employment.**  
**NOTE:** A formal pay-setting process will be used to determine your salary. The salary may be at any point in the range listed for this vacancy. Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religions; spiritual; community; student; social). Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. jobs.title: Treasury & Debt Manager
jobs.description:
**POSITION SUMMARY:**

The Treasury & Debt Manager will own the day-to-day treasury operating model and support the CFO with cash, debt, banking, liquidity, short-term investment, and treasury control matters. This role will help establish clear processes for cash forecasting, debt schedules, lender reporting, bank account administration, signer controls, customer deposit liquidity, and treasury reporting.

The position requires a hands-on treasury professional who can work across a growing global organization and partner closely with the Enterprise Controller, FP&A, Finance Systems / Oracle Transformation, operations, legal, external banking partners, and other stakeholders. The role is expected to improve visibility, strengthen controls, reduce key-person dependency, and create repeatable treasury processes that support accurate reporting and sound financial decision-making.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Treasury, Cash Forecasting, and Liquidity Management**

* Develop and maintain daily, weekly, and 13-week cash forecasting processes across the organization.
* Prepare recurring cash reporting for the CFO, including cash balances by bank, entity, currency, restricted status, and availability.
* Monitor liquidity needs, customer deposit activity, project-related cash requirements, payroll, AP disbursements, and other near-term cash uses.
* Partner with FP&A and operations to improve cash forecasting assumptions and connect project forecasts to expected cash receipts and disbursements.
* Identify excess cash that may be available for short-term investment while maintaining appropriate liquidity for operating and project needs.

**Debt Administration and Lender Reporting**

* Maintain the company’s debt schedule, including lender, entity, facility type, maturity, interest rate, collateral, covenant requirements, and reporting deadlines.
* Support preparation of lender reporting packages, covenant support, borrowing base information, availability analysis, and other bank-required schedules.
* Track interest expense, debt service requirements, letters of credit, guarantees, bonding exposure, and other treasury-related obligations.
* Coordinate with the CFO, accounting, legal, and external advisors on debt amendments, new facilities, renewals, guarantees, and required lender deliverables.
* Help develop reporting that gives leadership clear visibility into debt, liquidity, borrowing capacity, covenants, and treasury risk.

**Short-Term Investments and Customer Deposit Liquidity**

* Help establish a conservative short-term cash investment program designed to preserve principal, maintain liquidity, comply with restrictions, and optimize interest income.
* Evaluate short-term instruments such as bank deposits, sweep products, treasury money market funds, certificates of deposit, Treasury bills, or other CFO-approved options.
* Develop and maintain cash segmentation between operating cash, near-term liquidity reserves, project/customer deposits, restricted cash, and investable excess cash.
* Coordinate with the CFO and legal/accounting teams to understand customer deposit restrictions, project obligations, debt covenant considerations, and cash availability.
* Track investment maturities, earned interest, bank limits, counterparty exposure, and reporting needed for accounting and management review.

**Bank Administration, Signer Controls, and Treasury Processes**

* Manage bank account administration, including opening and closing accounts, maintaining authorized signer lists, reviewing online banking access, and supporting user access controls.
* Maintain banking relationship information, bank fee analysis, contact lists, and treasury service documentation.
* Strengthen approval workflows and controls over cash movement, wires, ACH payments, positive pay, account transfers, and bank platform access.
* Partner with the Enterprise Controller to align treasury activity with bank reconciliations, cash entries, balance sheet reporting, and internal control requirements.
* Develop and document treasury policies, procedures, calendars, and reporting routines.

**Reporting, Controls, and Cross-Functional Support**

* Create recurring treasury dashboards and schedules for cash, debt, liquidity, short-term investments, bank administration, and key treasury risks.
* Support audit requests, tax schedules, debt confirmations, bank confirmations, cash balance documentation, and other external reporting needs.
* Partner with the Finance Systems / Oracle Transformation Lead to improve treasury workflows, reporting automation, controls, and data integrity.
* Partner with AP, AR, payroll, corporate accounting, FP&A, project accounting, and subsidiary finance teams to resolve cash and treasury issues.
* Identify opportunities to reduce manual processes, eliminate key-person dependency, improve documentation, and strengthen treasury discipline.

**KNOWLEDGE / SKILL / ABILITY / EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or related field required.
* 5+ years of relevant experience in treasury, cash management, banking, corporate finance, debt administration, or related finance roles required; 7+ years preferred.
* Experience with debt schedules, lender reporting, covenants, letters of credit, guarantees, or bank facility administration strongly preferred.
* Experience with cash forecasting, liquidity management, bank administration, signer controls, and treasury process improvement required.
* Familiarity with short-term investment vehicles such as CDs, Treasury bills, money market funds, bank sweep products, or insured deposit programs preferred.
* Experience in a multi-entity, multi-bank, project-based, construction, EPC, manufacturing, energy, or privately held company environment strongly preferred.
* Strong Excel and analytical skills required; experience with ERP systems, treasury management systems, bank platforms, Power BI, or Oracle preferred.
* Strong understanding of internal controls over cash movement, banking access, and approval workflows.
* Ability to work cross-functionally with accounting, FP&A, operations, legal, external banks, auditors, and senior leadership.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to build repeatable processes, document procedures, and manage deadlines.
* High integrity, sound judgment, and discretion when handling sensitive cash, banking, debt, and financial information.
* CPA, CTP, MBA, or other relevant professional certification preferred but not required.

jobs.title: Finance Systems & Process Transformation Manager
jobs.description:
**POSITION SUMMARY:**

This position serves as the finance-side owner of systems transformation, workflow design, process automation, data governance, system adoption, and Oracle implementation coordination. The role reports directly to the CFO and partners closely with the Enterprise Controller, Financial Reporting, FP&A, Treasury & Debt Manager, Operations, IT, shared services, and implementation consultants.

The purpose of the role is to build structure, discipline, documentation, adoption, and repeatable workflows so Finance and Accounting can operate with less dependency on individual institutional knowledge and more reliance on well-designed systems and processes.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Finance Systems & Oracle Transformation**

* Lead finance-side coordination of Oracle implementation activities, including requirements gathering, issue tracking, testing, training, workflow design, data readiness, and post-go-live stabilization.
* Maintain the implementation roadmap, open issue log, decision log, testing status, risk register, and action-item tracker for Finance leadership.
* Coordinate with Oracle consultants, IT, Accounting, FP&A, Treasury, Operations, project teams, and shared services to resolve blockers and keep implementation work moving.
* Translate finance and accounting process needs into system requirements, user stories, test scripts, reporting requirements, and practical workflow changes.

**Workflow Redesign & Process Improvement**

* Map current-state and future-state processes across AP, AR, payroll interfaces, project accounting, job costing, procurement, billing, month-end close, approvals, intercompany, and reporting.
* Identify manual workarounds, duplicate entry, unclear ownership, control gaps, data issues, and process breakdowns; lead practical efforts to reduce or eliminate them.
* Partner with the Enterprise Controller to align system workflows with accounting operations, close discipline, controls, and escalation processes.
* Develop and maintain standard operating procedures, process maps, workflow documentation, and practical user guidance.

**Data Governance & Reporting Enablement**

* Support governance over key finance master data, including entities, chart of accounts, projects, cost codes, vendors, customers, intercompany relationships, approval hierarchies, and reporting dimensions.
* Help establish ownership, approval rules, and change controls for master data creation and modification.
* Coordinate reporting requirements with Financial Reporting, FP&A, Treasury, Accounting, and Operations to improve accuracy, usability, and consistency of Oracle-driven reporting.
* Validate system reports and data outputs against accounting records, close packages, management reporting, and business requirements.

**System Adoption, Training & Change Management**

* Lead user adoption activities, training coordination, communication routines, and practical support for finance and operational users.
* Identify areas where users continue to work outside the system and help transition those activities into controlled, repeatable processes.
* Create targeted training materials, user guides, quick-reference tools, and issue-resolution playbooks.
* Promote consistent system usage while escalating recurring errors, resistance, or process breakdowns to the appropriate functional leader.

**KNOWLEDGE / SKILL / ABILITY / EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, Information Systems, Operations, or a related field required.
* 7+ years of experience in finance systems, ERP implementation, finance transformation, accounting operations, business process improvement, or related roles preferred.
* Oracle experience strongly preferred; experience with other major ERP platforms such as SAP, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar systems also valued.
* Strong understanding of AP, AR, payroll interfaces, project accounting, job costing, month-end close, reporting, approvals, and internal controls.
* Experience with process mapping, requirements gathering, UAT, issue tracking, change management, system adoption, SOP development, and cross-functional project execution.
* Project management experience required; PMP, Lean Six Sigma, CPA, CMA, Oracle certifications, or related credentials a plus.
* Strong Excel skills required; experience with Power BI, SQL, reporting tools, workflow tools, or data visualization platforms preferred.
* Experience in construction, EPC, manufacturing, renewable energy, project-based businesses, multi-entity organizations, or shared services environments preferred.
* Ability to communicate effectively with executives, accounting teams, operations, IT, consultants, and end users.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, follow-through, and ability to manage competing priorities in a changing environment.

jobs.title: Manager, Business Analysis
jobs.description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Manager, Business Analysis
  
  
**Overview**
The Manager, Business Analysis is responsible for defining and executing modernization strategy, roadmap, and delivery for Mastercard's billing platform. This role drives initiatives, platform enhancements, and strategic transformation programs that improve scalability, operational efficiency, and business value across Mastercard's global billing ecosystem.
  
  
Operating at the intersection of business analysis, technology, and business operations, this role partners with engineering, business stakeholders, finance, and operations to deliver innovative solutions that support Mastercard's evolving business needs. The Manager, Business Analysis is accountable for translating complex business and technical requirements into actionable initiatives while ensuring alignment with strategic objectives and operational excellence. In addition to leading key initiatives directly, this role provides leadership, coaching, and mentorship to a small team of Senior Business Analysts.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Defines and maintains product backlogs in Jira, ensuring alignment with business priorities, customer needs, regulatory requirements, and modernization objectives
* Leads feature definition and backlog refinement, including:
* Writing clear epics, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria
* Translating complex business processes into scalable product capabilities
* Decomposing large initiatives into actionable and deliverable increments
* Ensuring work meets Definition of Ready and Definition of Done standards
* Drives billing modernization efforts, including platform rationalization, process standardization, and migration initiatives
* Partners with engineering teams to evaluate technical solutions, architecture decisions, and implementation approaches
* Prioritizes work based on business value, customer impact, risk mitigation, technical dependencies, and strategic alignment
* Collaborates with cross-functional stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Operations, Finance, and business teams to align requirements, priorities, and delivery outcomes
* Leads requirements gathering and solution design sessions to identify opportunities for process improvement and automation
* Supports large-scale transformation initiatives such as platform modernization, billing rule standardization, and payment ecosystem evolution
* Reviews and validates product deliverables through demos, testing activities, and stakeholder feedback
* Utilizes data, metrics, operational insights, and customer feedback to measure product performance and drive continuous improvement
* Identifies and manages product risks, dependencies, assumptions, and implementation challenges
* Creates and maintains product documentation, operational procedures, business requirements, and executive communications
* Communicates roadmap progress, strategic priorities, key decisions, risks, and outcomes to leadership and stakeholders at multiple organizational levels
* Leads and mentors a team of Senior Business Analysts while continuing to perform hands-on business analysis, requirements management, and modernization delivery activities
* Provides day-to-day leadership, coaching, workload prioritization, and development support for assigned Business Analysis team members
* Supports hiring, onboarding, performance management, and career development activities for direct reports
* Champions customer-centric product development practices and promotes agile methodologies across teams

**All About You**

* 7+ years of experience in Business Analysis, Product Management, Product Ownership, Program Delivery, or related disciplines
* Previous people leadership experience or demonstrated experience leading, mentoring, and developing Business Analysis professionals
* Proven experience leading complex enterprise platform initiatives and large-scale modernization programs
* Strong understanding of financial services, payment processing, billing systems, order management platforms, or transaction-based platforms
* Demonstrated ability to translate business objectives into technical requirements, solution designs, and executable delivery roadmaps
* Experience working in Agile environments utilizing Jira, Confluence, and related delivery tools
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to make data-driven decisions
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to engage technical and non-technical audiences
* Experience managing stakeholder relationships across business and technology organizations
* Ability to influence decisions and drive alignment without direct authority
* Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent initiatives while maintaining attention to detail and quality
* Ability to effectively balance hands-on delivery responsibilities with leadership and development of a small team
* Proven experience leading cross-functional teams and influencing business and technology stakeholders across complex initiatives
* Understanding of software development lifecycle, APIs, platform architecture, system integrations, and enterprise technology ecosystems
* Experience with payment systems, ISO 8583/ISO 20022, billing, order management, revenue management, or financial operations is preferred
* Demonstrated leadership capabilities with a collaborative and results-oriented approach
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; advanced degree preferred

Mastercard is a merit-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We hire the most qualified candidate for the role. In the US or Canada, if you require accommodations or assistance to complete the online application process or during the recruitment process, please contact reasonable\_accommodation@mastercard.com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly.
  
  
**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

In line with Mastercard’s total compensation philosophy and assuming that the job will be performed in the US, the successful candidate will be offered a competitive base salary and may be eligible for an annual bonus or commissions depending on the role. The base salary offered may vary depending on multiple factors, including but not limited to location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Mastercard benefits for full time (and certain part time) employees generally include: insurance (including medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, disability, life insurance); flexible spending account and health savings account; paid leaves (including 16 weeks of new parent leave and up to 20 days of bereavement leave); 80 hours of Paid Sick and Safe Time, 25 days of vacation time and 5 personal days, pro-rated based on date of hire; 10 annual paid U.S. observed holidays; 401k with a best-in-class company match; deferred compensation for eligible roles; fitness reimbursement or on-site fitness facilities; eligibility for tuition reimbursement; and many more. Mastercard benefits for interns generally include: 56 hours of Paid Sick and Safe Time; jury duty leave; and on-site fitness facilities in some locations.
  
  
**Pay Ranges**
O'Fallon, Missouri: $122,000 - $207,000 USD

Paradox Insurance Agency is where your drive meets opportunity, crafting a career that’s as rewarding as it is impactful. Join us and help shape the future of insurance!

**Position Overview:**

The Commercial Lines Client Service Manager (CSM) will support producers in managing main street select and complex commercial accounts across both standard and E&S markets.

You will be responsible for maintaining technical accuracy, coordinating with wholesalers and underwriters, managing renewals, and ensuring that surplus lines documentation, billing, and compliance standards are properly handled.

**What You’ll Do:**

* **Commercial & E&S Account Management**
* Manage standard and specialty commercial accounts, including E&S placements.
* Coordinate with underwriters, wholesale brokers, and surplus lines markets.
* Assist with remarketing and renewal strategy.
* Ensure surplus lines applications, billing, affidavits, and documentation are properly managed.
* Review policies for accuracy, endorsements, exclusions, and sublimits.
* **Renewal & Placement Execution**
* Conduct structured pre-renewal outreach and account reviews.
* Prepare submission materials and coordinate with producers on new and renewal business.
* Work directly with underwriters to negotiate renewals and endorsements.
* Identify coverage gaps or exposure shifts and elevate to producers when necessary.
* **Client Experience & Communication**
* Serve as primary service contact for assigned accounts.
* Issue certificates of insurance and review additional insured endorsements.
* Prepare proposals, premium finance agreements, and renewal summaries.
* Maintain clear, professional communication with clients and carrier partners.
* **Operational Discipline**
* Maintain data integrity within the agency management system.

The Clinical Practice Improvement Coordinator develops, implements and leads organizational initiatives based on the principles of high reliability, patient safety, quality improvement, accreditation continuous readiness, and regulatory compliance; facilitates physician peer review process to monitor and improve clinical outcomes; supports hospital teams and committees by serving as a facilitator and internal subject matter expert. Performs duties and responsibilities in a manner consistent with our mission and values. Principle Accountabilities: (% Time Spent)

* Regulatory Oversight:
  + Proactively leads the ongoing evaluation, planning and support of the continuous readiness infrastructure and processes to assess compliance with regulatory agencies, certifications and applicable organizational licenses.
  + Provides guidance on regulatory standards and requirements as they apply to organizational practices.
  + Collaborates with regulatory content experts and chapter leaders to identify risk areas and supports development, implementation and monitoring of regulatory improvement processes.
  + Develops regulatory education and reference materials and provides organizational communication and education plan.
  + Supports onsite accreditation and regulatory surveys and inspections; supports command center activities.
  + Provides expertise and leadership in the development and implementation of action plans including measurement support as needed for required follow-up and monitoring.
  + Supports responses to regulatory agencies as they relate to quality concerns.
  + Updates Joint Commission applications and coordinates submission of action plans through the website. Reviews and verifies accurate information is being submitted for external reporting.

  + Participates in improvement activities associated with abstracted data.
  + Identifies and communicates medical record discrepancies, clinical data discrepancies, practice pattern variances and clinical outcome trends.
  + Provides clinical feedback to improve patient care and facilitates clinical documentation enhancements.
  + Identifies and analyzes cases for process improvement, clinical quality reviews and physician peer review through chart reviews, audits and use of screening criteria which follow a culture of safety philosophy.
  + Supports designated Medical Staff Departments and facilitates physician peer review process to assist in identifying opportunities for clinical outcomes and process improvements.
  + Collects, analyzes and trends practitioner-specific data. Facilitates timely Ongoing Professional Practice Evaluations (OPPE) and review in collaboration with medical staff leaders.

Maintains professional and technical knowledge by attending educational workshops, reviewing professional publications, and establishing personal networks.

Our products support the defense industrial base and ensure that the men and women serving our country have reliable, high-quality equipment.

**How You Will Make a Difference**

As the Quality Manager, you will lead the facility’s quality function while remaining actively involved in the day-to-day work required to maintain product conformity and an effective Quality Management System. This includes supporting audits, reviewing quality documentation, investigating nonconformances, leading corrective actions, addressing customer concerns, and working directly with production and inspection teams.

This working-manager role combines quality-system leadership with hands-on problem solving throughout the manufacturing operation. You will serve as the primary quality representative for the facility while partnering with customers, auditors, suppliers, engineering, operations, programming, and inspection personnel to prevent quality issues, improve manufacturing performance, and ensure compliance with customer, aerospace and defense, and internal requirements.

*This position requires compliance with U.S. export control laws and regulations. As such, candidates must be a “U.S. Person” as defined by applicable law (e.g., U.S. citizen, U.S. national, lawful permanent resident, or asylee/refugee).*

**Key Responsibilities**

**Quality Management System and Compliance**

* Lead, maintain, and continuously improve the site’s Quality Management System in accordance with AS9100, ISO 9001, customer requirements, and applicable regulatory and contractual requirements.
* Ensure quality procedures, work instructions, forms, records, and supporting documentation remain current, effective, and properly controlled.
* Plan, coordinate, and support internal, customer, registrar, and regulatory audits.
* Manage audit findings and ensure corrective actions are completed effectively and within established timelines.
* Monitor changes to customer, industry, and regulatory requirements and incorporate applicable changes into site processes.
* Ensure product identification, traceability, record retention, calibration, configuration control, and other quality-system requirements are consistently maintained.

**Customer Quality and Product Conformance**

* Serve as the primary quality contact for customers and represent R&S during customer quality reviews, audits, investigations, and performance discussions.
* Review customer drawings, specifications, purchase-order requirements, quality clauses, and contractual requirements to ensure they are understood and incorporated into manufacturing and inspection processes.
* Oversee the preparation, review, and submission of First Article Inspection documentation in accordance with AS9102 and customer requirements.
* Manage customer complaints, returns, escapes, corrective-action requests, and quality-related communications.
* Ensure nonconforming product is appropriately identified, documented, segregated, reviewed, and dispositioned.
* Coordinate with customers and internal stakeholders regarding deviations, concessions, waivers, and material-review activities.

**Corrective Action and Continuous Improvement**

* Lead structured root-cause analysis and corrective-action activities involving customer complaints, internal nonconformances, audit findings, supplier issues, scrap, rework, and recurring process failures.
* Ensure corrective actions address underlying causes, are implemented effectively, and are verified for sustained results.
* Analyze quality performance data to identify trends, risks, recurring defects, and improvement opportunities.
* Partner with operations, engineering, programming, and inspection teams to improve process capability and prevent defects at the source.
* Promote the use of preventive quality methods, risk-based thinking, process controls, and lessons learned throughout the organization.

**Leadership and Department Management**

* Provide leadership, direction, and development for quality engineering and inspection personnel.
* Establish clear expectations, priorities, responsibilities, and performance standards for the quality organization.
* Partner with the Inspection Lab Manager to ensure inspection resources, equipment, programming capability, and priorities support production and customer requirements.
* Evaluate staffing, training, equipment, software, and capital needs for the quality function.
* Support employee development through coaching, technical training, cross-training, and succession planning.
* Build a culture in which quality concerns are communicated openly, investigated objectively, and resolved collaboratively.

**Supplier and Operational Quality**

* Support supplier qualification, monitoring, performance evaluation, corrective action, and approved-supplier requirements.
* Work with purchasing and operations to address supplier-related material, processing, documentation, and certification issues.
* Participate in contract review, quoting, new-product introduction, process planning, and production-readiness activities.
* Ensure quality requirements are clearly transferred from customer documentation into routers, inspection plans, work instructions, and production processes.
* Support control plans, PFMEAs, inspection planning, measurement strategies, and other risk-reduction activities.
* Provide timely escalation of significant product, customer, compliance, or delivery risks to site and company leadership.

**Quality Metrics and Reporting**

* Establish and monitor meaningful quality metrics, including customer escapes, internal nonconformances, scrap, rework, corrective-action effectiveness, audit performance, supplier quality, and first-pass yield.
* Provide regular quality-performance updates to site and company leadership.
* Use data to prioritize improvement initiatives and allocate quality resources.
* Maintain visibility into open quality issues and ensure assigned actions are completed on time.

*This position requires compliance with U.S. export control laws and regulations. As such, candidates must be a “U.S. Person” as defined by applicable law (e.g., U.S. citizen, U.S. national, lawful permanent resident, or asylee/refugee).*

**Basic Qualifications**

* At least seven (7) years of quality experience within aerospace, defense, precision machining, or another highly regulated manufacturing environment.
* At least three (3) years of experience leading quality, inspection, or quality-engineering personnel.
* Experience with AS9100 or ISO 9001 quality standards and preparing for and leading internal, customer, and third-party audits.

**Preferred Qualifications (in addition to Basic Qualifications)**

* Bachelor’s Degree
* Experience in an aerospace and defense precision CNC machining environment.
* Experience with AS9100.
* Certified Quality Manager, Certified Quality Engineer, Certified Quality Auditor, Six Sigma, or similar professional certification.
* Experience working with customer portals and aerospace quality systems such as Net-Inspect or equivalent platforms.
* Familiarity with CMM inspection, CMM programming, calibration systems, and advanced dimensional measurement methods.
* Experience supporting special-process requirements, supplier quality, or NADCAP-controlled processes.

**Skills and Competencies**

* Experience managing customer complaints, nonconforming material, corrective actions, and root-cause investigations.
* Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, tolerances, and geometric dimensioning and tolerancing.
* Understanding of precision CNC machining, manufacturing processes, inspection methods, and product traceability.
* Strong written, verbal, organizational, analytical, and leadership skills.
* Ability to communicate effectively with customers, auditors, employees, suppliers, and leadership.
* Strong knowledge of aerospace quality systems, customer requirements, and precision-manufacturing quality practices.
* Ability to balance customer, compliance, production, cost, and delivery requirements without compromising product conformity.
* Strong problem-solving and root-cause-analysis capability.
* Ability to lead difficult quality discussions objectively and constructively.
* Sound judgment and the confidence to stop or contain work when product conformity is at risk.
* Ability to establish priorities, manage multiple issues, and follow actions through completion.
* Hands-on, collaborative leadership style with a strong presence on the manufacturing floor.
* Commitment to accountability, continuous improvement, and defect prevention.

**EEO Statement**

Threadlock Precision is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

jobs.description:
Hiring Department
  
  
Admissions
  
  
**Job Description**
**Position Summary**
Reporting to the Director of International Admissions & Global Enrollment Resources, the International Admission Program Manager is responsible for overseeing the daily operations of the international admissions office at the University of Missouri-St. Louis (UMSL). This role works collaboratively with the Director of International Admissions & Global Enrollment Resources and Associate Directors for International Recruitment to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of international admissions processes. Must have US Citizenship or Legal Permanent Residency as per US Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) guidelines for DSOs.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
International Admissions Operations
  
  

* Implements and maintains international admissions procedures to support the efficient, accurate, and consistent processing of undergraduate and graduate applications.
* Exercises independent judgment when reviewing applications, resolving applicant concerns, and interpreting admissions policies and procedures.
* Reviews applications and supporting documentation to determine admissibility in accordance with institutional policies and established practices.
* Ensures timely and accurate processing of admission decisions and applicant communications.
* Maintains effective working relationships with students, faculty, advisors, administrators, and recruitment partners.
* Identifies operational challenges and recommends process improvements to enhance efficiency and service delivery.
* Maintains accurate student records and admissions data within university systems.

International Credential Evaluation & Transfer Credit
  
  

* Evaluates international academic credentials and transfer coursework to support admissions decisions, academic placement, and degree progression.
* Determines U.S. educational equivalencies, transferable credit, grade conversions, and cumulative GPA calculations for international transcripts.
* Facilitates international transfer credit evaluations in accordance with university policies and articulation agreements.
* Maintains expertise in international educational systems, transfer credit practices, and credential evaluation methodologies.
* Interprets and communicates evaluation results, transfer credit policies, and academic requirements to students, faculty, and staff.

Compliance, Documentation & Student Records
  
  

* Administers processes that support compliance with institutional policies and applicable regulatory requirements related to international admissions and student records.
* Reviews documentation to ensure adherence to admissions policies, credential verification standards, and established procedures.
* Identifies and escalates cases involving suspected fraud, policy exceptions, or other compliance concerns.
* Collaborates with Global Students & Experiences staff to support documentation review and processes related to I-20 and DS-2019 issuance.
* Maintains accurate records and documentation to support reporting, auditing, and regulatory compliance.
* Ensures the confidentiality and appropriate handling of applicant and student information.

Scholarships & Student Support
  
  

* Determines scholarship eligibility and award amounts in accordance with institutional guidelines.
* Reviews scholarship awards and notifications for accuracy.
* Serves as a liaison with Student Financial Services and other campus partners to assist students in resolving funding-related concerns.
* Provides information regarding admissions requirements, scholarships, transfer credit, and enrollment procedures.

Operational Support & Special Projects
  
  

* Coordinates the work of student assistants engaged in document processing, record maintenance, data entry, and related operational activities.
* Develops and maintains procedural documentation and training resources.
* Participates in special projects and initiatives that support the admission, enrollment, retention, and engagement of international students.
* Performs other duties as assigned in support of departmental and university goals.

40 hours/week. Monday thru Friday.

A Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education and experience and at least 2 years of experience from which comparable knowledge and skills can be acquired is necessary
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**

* Demonstrated commitment to providing exceptional customer service with the ability to work effectively both independently and as a collaborative member of a team.
* Two or more years of experience in international admissions, international recruitment, or a closely related field.
* Strong attention to detail with experience handling confidential information and maintaining a high standard of data accuracy and integrity.
* Proven ability to independently manage projects from initiation through completion while maintaining effective communication with admissions leadership and key stakeholders.
* Knowledge of the higher education admissions landscape, particularly international admissions, and an interest in emerging trends and issues affecting the field.
* Flexibility and willingness to work evenings, weekends, and extended hours during peak recruitment and admissions cycles.
* Experience using higher education CRM and student information systems, with preference given to candidates familiar with PeopleSoft, Slate, Enroll ML, or similar enterprise platforms.

FlightSafety International is the world’s premier professional aviation training company and supplier of flight simulators, visual systems and displays to commercial, government and military organizations. The company provides training for pilots, technicians and other aviation professionals from 167 countries and independent territories. FlightSafety operates the world’s largest fleet of advanced full-flight simulators and award-winning maintenance training at Learning Centers and training locations in the United States, Canada, France and the United Kingdom.
  
  
**Purpose of Position**

Identifies areas of improvement, creates projects, works on projects, manages and tracks the progress of programs and projects to support company's short and long-range goals and objective focusing on process improvement objectives.
  
  
**Tasks And Responsibilities**

Interviewing, hiring, and training employees; planning, assigning and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems.

**Knowledge, Skills, Abilities**

* Word processing
* Email

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit. The employee frequently is required to talk or hear. The employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally exposed to moving mechanical parts and fumes or airborne particles. FlightSafety is an Equal Opportunity Employer/Vet/Disabled. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability.

This position may require access to export-controlled technology or services subject to the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and/or the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). Employment consideration and any offer of employment are contingent upon the applicant’s ability to comply with these requirements, including qualifying as a “U.S. Person” under applicable regulations or otherwise eligible for export authorization within a timeframe consistent with business needs. A “U.S. Person” includes U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents (holders of approved and unexpired green cards), and certain refugees or asylees with protected status under U.S. law.
  
  
This position may also require eligibility to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance for the duration of employment.

email address. FlightSafety International will never ask for personal or financial information through social media or third-party email providers.

jobs.title: Lead Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Lead Technical Program Manager
  
  
The AI & Decision Product Enablement Program (AI & DPE) is a transformative internal product suite that powers intelligent, data-driven decision-making across market-facing financial products. It delivers industry leading intelligence by applying complex business logic throughout the payment lifecycle and broader financial ecosystem, enabling real-time, scalable decisions that directly impact revenue, cost efficiency, and risk management.
  
  
The platform leverages supercomputing, advanced business rules, AI/ML technologies, agentic AI frameworks, streaming big data platforms, high-speed in-memory caching, APIs, and user interfaces to enrich financial data and drive measurable business outcomes.
  
  
As we expand our capabilities, we are investing in AI Agents to automate decisioning, accelerate operational workflows, and enhance financial insights, ranging from real-time transaction intelligence to forecasting, anomaly detection, and executive reporting.
  
  
We are seeking a self-driven highly motivated Lead Technical Program Manager with strong financial domain expertise and hands-on experience delivering AI-driven and agent-based solutions. This role is pivotal in driving execution across complex programs, ensuring alignment between product, engineering, and finance stakeholders, and delivering high-impact capabilities that improve financial performance and decision velocity. This role ensures successful execution against prioritized commitments and fosters alignment across cross-functional teams.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead end-to-end delivery of large-scale, cross-functional programs spanning AI platforms, financial systems, and agent-based solutions.
* Drive roadmap planning, dependency management, risk mitigation, and execution rigor across multiple workstreams.
* Partner with engineering and product teams to design, develop, and operationalize AI Agents (e.g., decision agents, reporting agents, workflow automation agents).
* Ensure agents are scalable, governed, and aligned to enterprise standards for accuracy, explainability, and risk controls.
* Lead initiatives involving financial data, cost tracking, forecasting, and P&L impact analysis.
* Ensure tight integration between financial data sources to enable realtime insights and measurable business outcomes.
* Develop and implement strategies to ensure system resiliency, financial accuracy, and operational stability.
* Embed financial governance, auditability, and risk controls into AI-driven decision systems and automation workflows.
* Translate complex technical and financial concepts into clear, executive ready insights for leadership forums.
* Support Agile Release Trains and drive Program Increment (PI) planning and execution.
* Define KPIs and OKRs that measure both technical performance and financial/business impact.
* Stay at the forefront of AI/ML and agentic frameworks, identifying opportunities to drive automation and intelligent decisioning across the enterprise.
* Continuously evaluate financial and operational performance to optimize program outcomes.
* Mentor TPMs and cross-functional team members, fostering strong program discipline and outcome-driven execution.

**About You**

* Strong experience working with financial systems, cost modeling, forecasting, budgeting, or transaction-based platforms.
* Ability to connect technical delivery to financial outcomes (revenue impact, cost efficiency, margin improvement, risk reduction).
* Proven experience delivering solutions leveraging AI/ML technologies and/or AI Agents (LLMs, automation agents).
* Familiarity with concepts such as prompt design, agent orchestration, model governance, and AI risk management.
* Proven success leading complex programs involving distributed systems, data platforms, and AI technologies.
* Strong ability to manage dependencies, critical path, and cross-team execution at scale.
* Exceptional communication skills with the ability to influence senior leadership and drive alignment.
* Ability to synthesize complex topics into clear, concise, and actionable insights.
* Experience working with technologies such as big data platforms, APIs, streaming systems, caching layers, and decisioning engines.
* Ability to engage deeply with engineering teams and challenge assumptions.
* Strong understanding of Agile, SAFe, and SDLC practices with experience driving delivery in fast-paced environments.

Proficiency with Aha, Jira, Confluence, Tableau/Power BI, DOMO, or similar tools.
  
  
Mastercard is a merit-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We hire the most qualified candidate for the role. In the US or Canada, if you require accommodations or assistance to complete the online application process or during the recruitment process, please contact reasonable\_accommodation@mastercard.com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly.
  
  
**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

In line with Mastercard’s total compensation philosophy and assuming that the job will be performed in the US, the successful candidate will be offered a competitive base salary and may be eligible for an annual bonus or commissions depending on the role. The base salary offered may vary depending on multiple factors, including but not limited to location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Mastercard benefits for full time (and certain part time) employees generally include: insurance (including medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, disability, life insurance); flexible spending account and health savings account; paid leaves (including 16 weeks of new parent leave and up to 20 days of bereavement leave); 80 hours of Paid Sick and Safe Time, 25 days of vacation time and 5 personal days, pro-rated based on date of hire; 10 annual paid U.S. observed holidays; 401k with a best-in-class company match; deferred compensation for eligible roles; fitness reimbursement or on-site fitness facilities; eligibility for tuition reimbursement; and many more. Mastercard benefits for interns generally include: 56 hours of Paid Sick and Safe Time; jury duty leave; and on-site fitness facilities in some locations.
  
  
**Pay Ranges**
O'Fallon, Missouri: $122,000 - $207,000 USD

*Kairos Academies has been recognized by Forbes, Education Week, and NBC Today for reimagining 21st-century education—replacing passive lectures with hands-on projects and “behavior managers” with 1:1 executive-functioning mentors. We develop self-governing citizens ready to lead themselves and their communities.*

**Description**
The
**Human Resource Business Partner**
functions in a strategic business partner role to provide and facilitate HR strategies and services. In this role you will serve as the primary HR contact to Department Head (s) and Senior Leaders of your assigned Business segment, business unit and operating units on all HR programs, and regularly provides HR status updates to the HR Management team. The HRBP will interact with all levels of the organization including managers, employees, and HR colleagues to ensure timely and effective delivery of HR services in supporting business initiatives.
  
  
The role requires strategic, operational and project management skills ensuring HR remains an active contributor to the success and goals of your assigned Business segment, business unit and operating units. Utilizing your functional experience, flexibility, creativity, and project management skills, you will assist on special projects and new program development as needed.
  
  
Must have excellent interpersonal, organizational, communication and presentation skills. Must be able to facilitate in meetings where emotions may be high. Must possess sound judgment and ability to listen, assess problems and arrive at good logical solutions that achieve an appropriate balance between sound HR practices and business needs. Must be confident, credible, professional, and well respected. Capable of managing multiple assignments/tasks concurrently. Must be able to work effectively and efficiently in a matrix management environment.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Strategic Advisor
* Must be regarded by business leaders/managers as a qualified consultant/advisor in Human Resource practices. Provide thought leadership related to assigned client team and regularly update Senior Management while acting as a catalyst for sustained business performance, ensuring HR strategies are relevant and translated into concrete actions with tangible results.
* Act as a “talent agent” to help identify, develop, and deploy talent to meet short- and long-term business requirements. by partnering with management and COE teams to continually evaluate and develop employees within the organization including career planning, skill building and competency modeling.
* Use data analytics and external/internal insights to design innovative HR solutions based on short and long-term business needs.
* Performs talent and organization diagnostics to align with and drive strategy.
* Implements innovative solutions that deliver the highest value and impact.
* Business Coach & Consultant
* Quickly build and leverage strong relationships with business leaders to position HR priorities and influence business strategy.
* Ability to assess and communicate leaders’ blind spots and provide recommendations to overcome barriers.

* Keep abreast of legislation affecting associate relations. Educate managers and support business practices to minimize risk to the company.
* Change Agent
* Own transformation process in partnership with business leaders.
* Utilize data analytics to anticipate change and measure impacts.
* Identifies risks to the delivery of the business strategy and brings the right resources forward to manage.

* Lead initiatives ranging from complex to highly complex that have a significant impact. Innovate on existing programs to help leaders look around corners to drive success.
* Ensure Service are delivered (Time/Cost/Value/Quality) according to SLAs.
* Knowledgeable of processes and guidelines to guide associates and managers.
* Proactively leverage HR system data for client groups and other reporting vehicles to maintain high integrity of employee and organizational data; provide management information analysis using data and metrics that give insight on people issues including retention, performance management, engagement, and conflict.
* Proactively plan and carry out policies and practices for Human Resources in compliance with current state and federal law in supporting regional business plans and initiatives
* Artificial Intelligence
* Leverages AI‑driven tools to enhance talent acquisition, workforce planning, and employee experience.
* Applies generative AI solutions (e.g., M365 Copilot, recruiting automation platforms) to streamline sourcing, screening, and communication workflows.
* Interprets AI‑generated insights to support data‑driven decision‑making in HR strategy, trends, and performance management.
* Other duties as assigned

* High School Diploma/GED
* Bachelors and Master’s degree preferred
* Some experience may be substituted for some of the above education.
* PHR/SPHR preferred

**Work Experience**

* 8-10+ years of relevant work experience
* 1-3+ years of supervisory/management experience.

**Knowledge, Skills And Abilities**

* Strong decision-making capabilities with extensive experience interpreting information to make business decisions and recommendations
* Extensive experience partnering and using a consultative approach with stakeholders
* Creative, entrepreneur mindset that is solution orientated
* Global & Cultural effectiveness
* Business Acumen - understanding and applying information to contribute to the organization's strategic business and people plan.

Headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri with more than 1,200 employees and nearing $2B in revenue, Alberici is a diversified construction company that partners with leading organizations throughout North America to build their most challenging and important projects.
  
  
Since our founding in 1918, Alberici earned a reputation for executing with quality, safety and trust. Combined with our 100+ years of experience, we provide construction solutions to the automotive, commercial, civil, energy, food & beverage, healthcare, heavy industrial, industrial process, and water industries.
  
  
***We build the critical structures that improve lives and strengthen communities.***
Our mission is simple — and our approach to delivering on it is equally straightforward. We are as open and honest with our employees and partners as we are with our clients. We are here to work together to do the best work possible to bring this mission to life.
  
  
When it comes to our team, Alberici employees are built differently. We seek the best and brightest and are committed to investing in our people and providing the training and resources they need to learn, grow, and advance.
  
  
Are you
**Built for the Challenge**
?
  
  
**Our Values**

* Working Safely
* Valuing Diversity
* Serving Humbly
* Executing with Integrity
* Solving Creatively
* Engaging Fully

**What We Offer**

* Profit-sharing plan, cash bonus programs and annual cost-of-living adjustments
* Generous salary increases and per diems for qualified out-of-town assignments
* Health, dental and vision insurance eligibility on day one
* Paid parental leave
* Continuing education reimbursement
* Personalized career development and training programs
* Minimum of 29 days of PTO (including holidays) for entry-level roles
* Fitness center for St. Louis office-based team members
* Gym membership reimbursement for project-based team members
* Corporate office cafeteria access
* Employee Resource Group (ERG) opportunities

The Human Resources Business Partner assists the Human Resources department with a variety of functions related to employee and labor relations, compliance, performance improvement, paid leave administration, and reporting.

* Lead complaint investigations and manage the litigation process.
* Conduct employee investigations related to EEO violations and charges.
* Ensure compliance with state Paid Leave programs.

* Manage Affirmative Action Plan (AAP) compliance processes.

The position will have both client-facing responsibilities and an internal enablement component.  
  
Recruiting for this role ends on August 31, 2026

* Shaping and lead early-stage product development and product incubation projects with a focus on rapid prototyping using cutting edge generative AI tools.

This role combines deep marketing strategy expertise with consulting leadership, Health Care commercial acumen, and the credibility to serve as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders across the full breadth of the Chief Marketing Officer's agenda.  
  
As a Senior Manager, you will:  

* Provide oversight and expert guidance across multiple concurrent marketing strategy engagements, spanning the breadth of the CMO agenda including operating model transformation, growth and margin improvement opportunities, resource allocation and investment decision-making, audience segmentation, marketing and campaign strategy, and AI-enablement strategy
* Serve as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders, leading executive readouts and decision-ready recommendations with credibility and authority
* Drive pipeline and sales generation activities, including leading proposal responses, shaping client solutions, and supporting business development across the practice
* Contribute to and lead thought leadership efforts that build the practice's reputation and market presence
* Confidently lead teams to strong outcomes while managing scope, timelines, risks, dependencies, and client needs across engagements
* Maintain comfort with the more technical aspects of marketing, including MarTech stacks, platforms, tools, and the implications of AI, to guide broader marketing transformation engagements
* Use advanced analytics and AI-enabled tools to improve efficiency, insight generation, and work quality
* Lead, coach, and develop teams while fostering an inclusive, high-performing culture and modeling Deloitte leadership behaviors

  
A successful candidate would possess these skills:  

* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead multiple projects concurrently
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to proactively identify and address potential challenges to effective delivery of work products before they happen
* Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others
